platforms.name: CJSR 88.5 FM Official Digital Album/EP Email and Physical Submission Route
platforms.country: Canada / Edmonton independent community radio accepting international digital and physical releases
platforms.feeAmount: No fee is required for music submission. CJSR separately advertises an optional CAD 200 local-release advertising package, which is not part of the submission route.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJSR accepts only albums or EPs, not single tracks. Digital servicing must provide downloadable files through a Bandcamp code or durable cloud link rather than Spotify, Tidal or another paid stream; expiring transfer links are discouraged. The package needs clear artist, album and track identification, focus tracks, track lengths, language warnings and tagged audio. CJSR's January 2026 AI policy states it will not air music wholly generated by AI, so a human must verify MarcsMusic's production provenance and eligibility, prepare compliant assets and metadata and send the email or physical package manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CJSR's official submission guidance, January 2026 AI policy and active homepage, which displayed a chart and Hot Wax update dated July 7, 2026. The purpose-specific music@cjsr.com address is publicly displayed. The optional paid advertising product is separate from free music consideration. No email was sent, no files or download code were supplied and no physical package was prepared.

platforms.name: CFUV 101.9 FM Official Digital Music Department Email Route
platforms.country: Canada / Victoria freeform campus-community radio with direct digital music intake
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated in CFUV's official music-submission guidelines.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CFUV requires at least three unique tracks and asks for minimum 320-kbps MP3 files through a digital download link sent to music@cfuv.ca. The submission should include a one-page biography, artist or band name, album title and complete track listing; missing track listings are not considered. Physical servicing is generally limited to artists local to Victoria, Sooke, Duncan or the Gulf Islands. A human must confirm the release contains enough eligible tracks, prepare the download permissions and metadata and send the email manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CFUV's official submission page, current weekly-show schedule and Music Director contact details. The purpose-specific music@cfuv.ca address is publicly displayed and the station lists active weekly and monthly programming. No email was sent, no audio or biography was delivered and no local eligibility was claimed.

platforms.name: CFRU 93.3 FM Official Digital EP/Album Email Route
platforms.country: Canada / Guelph campus-community radio accepting general digital EP and album submissions
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated in CFRU's official music-submission guidance.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CFRU's general route accepts EPs or albums with at least three different songs. Artists must email download links to music@cfru.ca and include artist and album information, track listings and contact details; 320-kbps MP3 is preferred. CFRU is digital-only except in rare circumstances. Its separate upload form is restricted to musicians within 50 km of Guelph and is not the MarcsMusic route. A human must prepare the eligible multi-track release, verify link access and metadata and send the general email manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CFRU's official music page, which names the Music Director, publishes music@cfru.ca and displayed charts dated July 7, 2026. The local-only upload form was identified but excluded for MarcsMusic. No email or form was submitted and no local status was asserted.

platforms.name: CJAM 99.1 FM Official Digital Album Email Route
platforms.country: Canada / Windsor-Detroit campus-community radio with digital-only album intake
platforms.feeAmount: No submission fee or payment requirement is stated in CJAM's official digital-submission guidance.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJAM has moved to digital-only submissions and requires a release with at least four original tracks. Artists must email cjammd@gmail.com with release information and a reliable download link, preferably Dropbox, WeTransfer or Google Drive; direct MP3 attachments and Spotify links are rejected. Audio must be at least 192 kbps in MP3 or AAC, with FLAC also accepted, and files need complete ID tags. A human must verify the four-track threshold, prepare the download package and EPK or concise release context and send manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CJAM's official submission page and active homepage, which displayed July 2026 Singles Club content and charts for June 29 to July 5, 2026. The purpose-specific Music Director address is publicly displayed. No email was sent and no files, EPK or download link were delivered.

platforms.name: CJSF 90.1 FM National Music Director Form and Music Coordinator Route
platforms.country: Canada / Burnaby campus-community radio participating in national !earshot distribution
platforms.feeAmount: CJSF states no submission fee on its official music page. A separate !earshot Distro registration or distribution option may have its own terms and must not be assumed free without live review.
platforms.manualReviewReason: CJSF provides an official National Music Director submission form and publicly lists cjsfmusc@sfu.ca for music submissions. The form states that submission grants broadcast rights to CJSF and partner campus/community stations, asks the submitter to be an authorized rights holder and offers optional identity and discoverability labels. Singles may enter !earshot Distro but are not considered for CJSF's local library; non-local physical releases are not accepted. Because the embedded form's full live fields, anti-spam controls and any !earshot account or distribution terms are not statically visible, a human must inspect the workflow, approve rights and identity disclosures and submit manually.
platforms.notes: Verified on 2026-07-12 from CJSF's official music and submissions pages and active homepage, which showed programs aired July 7-9, 2026. The station's public Music Coordinator email was verified on the official site. No form was opened beyond the public page, no account was used, no broadcast-rights grant or identity disclosure was made and no email was sent.
